description: Verified examples added to the Cypher prompt. Queries return restaurant_id plus computed values only (and anchor_id when starting from a named restaurant); the application adds the restaurant details. Non-query examples show the action (clarify, explain, decline) with its reply and options. Each query must pass the validator (tests/test_cypher_and_answers.py). Use only ontology.json names and categories.json values.

examples.question: Halal Japanese restaurants in SS 2 under RM30
examples.cypher:
MATCH (r:Restaurant {business_status: 'OPERATIONAL'})-[:SERVES]->(:Cuisine {name: 'Japanese'})
MATCH (r)-[:HAS_PROFILE]->(:BusinessProfile {halal_status: 'halal'})
MATCH (r)-[:PRICED_AT]->(p:PriceRange)
WHERE p.avg_meal_price < $max_price
MATCH (r)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(:Location)-[:IN_AREA]->(a:Area)
WHERE a.name =~ $area_pattern
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:HAS_RATING]->(rt:Rating)
RETURN r.restaurant_id AS restaurant_id
ORDER BY coalesce(rt.rating_score, 0) DESC, coalesce(rt.total_reviews, 0) DESC
LIMIT 5

examples.question: Who are the competitors of Village Park Restaurant?
examples.cypher:
MATCH (t:Restaurant)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(:Location)-[:IN_AREA]->(ta:Area)
WITH t, toLower(t.name + ' ' + coalesce(ta.name, '')) AS label
WHERE all(word IN $name_words WHERE label CONTAINS word)
MATCH (t)-[:COMPETES_WITH]-(r:Restaurant {business_status: 'OPERATIONAL'})
WITH DISTINCT r, t
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:HAS_RATING]->(rt:Rating)
RETURN r.restaurant_id AS restaurant_id, t.restaurant_id AS anchor_id, t.name AS competitor_of
ORDER BY coalesce(rt.rating_score, 0) DESC, coalesce(rt.total_reviews, 0) DESC
LIMIT 5

examples.question: Cafes near Village Park Restaurant
examples.cypher:
MATCH (t:Restaurant)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(:Location)-[:IN_AREA]->(ta:Area)
WITH t, toLower(t.name + ' ' + coalesce(ta.name, '')) AS label
WHERE all(word IN $name_words WHERE label CONTAINS word)
MATCH (t)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(tl:Location)
MATCH (r:Restaurant {business_status: 'OPERATIONAL', amenity_type: 'cafe'})-[:LOCATED_IN]->(l:Location)
WHERE r <> t
WITH t, r, point.distance(point({latitude: l.latitude, longitude: l.longitude}),
                          point({latitude: tl.latitude, longitude: tl.longitude})) AS distance_m
WHERE distance_m <= $default_radius_m
RETURN r.restaurant_id AS restaurant_id, round(distance_m) AS distance_m,
       t.restaurant_id AS anchor_id, t.name AS near_place
ORDER BY distance_m
LIMIT 5

examples.question: Summarise the food scene in Kota Damansara for me
examples.cypher:
MATCH (r:Restaurant {business_status: 'OPERATIONAL'})-[:LOCATED_IN]->(:Location)-[:IN_AREA]->(a:Area)
WHERE toLower(a.name) CONTAINS toLower($place)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:HAS_RATING]->(rt:Rating)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:PRICED_AT]->(p:PriceRange)
WITH a, count(DISTINCT r) AS restaurants, round(avg(rt.rating_score) * 10) / 10 AS average_rating,
     round(avg(p.avg_meal_price)) AS average_meal_price
RETURN a.name AS area_name, restaurants, average_rating, average_meal_price,
       COLLECT { MATCH (x:Restaurant {business_status: 'OPERATIONAL'})-[:LOCATED_IN]->(:Location)-[:IN_AREA]->(a)
                 MATCH (x)-[:SERVES]->(c:Cuisine)
                 WITH c.name AS cuisine, count(DISTINCT x) AS places ORDER BY places DESC LIMIT 5
                 RETURN cuisine + ' (' + toString(places) + ')' } AS top_cuisines,
       COLLECT { MATCH (x:Restaurant {business_status: 'OPERATIONAL'})-[:LOCATED_IN]->(:Location)-[:IN_AREA]->(a)
                 MATCH (x)-[:PRICED_AT]->(q:PriceRange)
                 WITH q.tier AS tier, count(DISTINCT x) AS places ORDER BY places DESC
                 RETURN tier + ' (' + toString(places) + ')' } AS price_tiers
LIMIT 5

examples.question: Are the reviews for Hayaki good?

MATCH (r:Restaurant)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(:Location)-[:IN_AREA]->(a:Area)
WITH r, toLower(r.name + ' ' + coalesce(a.name, '')) AS label

RETURN r.name AS restaurant, v.sentiment AS sentiment, v.individual_rating AS stars,

examples.question: Will a ramen shop succeed in Seksyen 17?
examples.cypher:
MATCH (r:Restaurant {business_status: 'OPERATIONAL'})-[:LOCATED_IN]->(:Location)-[:IN_AREA]->(a:Area)
WHERE a.name =~ $area_pattern
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:HAS_RATING]->(rt:Rating)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:PRICED_AT]->(p:PriceRange)
RETURN a.name AS area_name, count(DISTINCT r) AS restaurants,
       count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS { MATCH (r)-[:SERVES]->(:Cuisine {name: 'Japanese'}) } THEN r END) AS japanese_restaurants,
       round(avg(rt.rating_score) * 10) / 10 AS average_rating, round(avg(p.avg_meal_price)) AS average_meal_price
LIMIT 1

examples.question: What's the difference between a kopitiam and a mamak?
examples.reply: A kopitiam is a traditional coffee shop with local drinks, toast and simple meals, often with several food stalls inside. A mamak is an Indian Muslim eatery known for roti canai, nasi kandar and teh tarik, and many stay open late.
